name: FutureClinic
long_description:
FutureClinic is the world's largest agent-native medical clinic: over 300 doctors (generalists and specialists, covering over 63 specialty types) you can reach directly from Claude, ChatGPT or whichever AI agent you already use. 

Hundreds of millions of people use AI models to better understand their own health. But when it comes time to take that information and turn it into medical care, they're left going back to the broken healthcare system, waiting months for a rushed appointment, and feeling frustrated that their doctor doesn't have the time to digest the research they've done with their AI. 

Now, you can ask your AI to bring in a real doctor into that same conversation. A physician reads your whole case and answers you personally, typically within a few hours, and sends a live recorded video called a Human Signature with their response so you know you're getting real care from an expert every time.

They can diagnose, prescribe to the pharmacy you choose, order lab tests and even imaging when needed. A visit is $40, with no insurance, appointment or subscription needed, in 33 states and Washington, D.C. You can also start at futureclinic.com. 

For doctors, FutureClinic is the way to become a personal doctor to patients directly. Build your own AI-native clinic for free in under 3 minutes, get found by the AI agents patients already turn to for help, and set your own prices and hours. Malpractice coverage is included. It’s care on your terms, where you're in control, with no private equity owner or hospital system standing between you and your patients.
